Machine Learning Engineer (Junior)
Sable AI

We deploy models, we do not just train them. This role is closer to software
engineering than to research.

The job
- Take models from notebooks into production services
- Build data pipelines that feed training and inference
- Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation
- Write the tests and tooling that make the above repeatable

Must have
- Strong Python — this is the core requirement of the role
- Understanding of machine learning fundamentals: training, validation,
  overfitting, evaluation metrics
- Experience with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred)
- SQL
- Git and collaborative development

Strongly preferred
- Experience deploying a model to production, in any capacity
- Docker
- Cloud platform experience, ideally AWS SageMaker or GCP Vertex AI
- Familiarity with MLOps tooling such as MLflow or Weights & Biases

A plus
- Kubernetes
- Experience with feature stores
- Publications or competition results
- Contributions to open source ML projects

A research background is not required and a PhD is not expected.
